elements.element: Customer is not subject to any restriction on soliciting Vendor employees or personnel.
elements.evidence: Rendered Section 12.4 expressly states that “Customer is not subject to any non-solicitation...restriction with respect to Vendor personnel.”

elements.element: The non-solicitation restriction binds Customer and Vendor mutually.
elements.evidence: No non-solicitation restriction is imposed on either party; the clause instead affirmatively exempts Customer.

elements.element: The mutual restriction applies only to personnel directly involved in the Services.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no mutual restriction or direct-involvement scope limitation.

elements.element: For each covered person, the restriction lasts no more than 12 months after that person’s involvement in the Services ends.
elements.evidence: The rendered language contains no non-solicitation period or person-specific end-of-involvement trigger.

elements.element: General advertisements are excluded from the mutual non-solicitation restriction.
elements.evidence: Section 12.3 protects Customer’s hiring of persons responding to general recruitment, but it does not create the required carve-out from a mutual non-solicitation restriction.

elements.element: Unsolicited approaches by personnel are excluded from the mutual non-solicitation restriction.
elements.evidence: No unsolicited-approach carve-out appears in the operative language.

elements.element: Neither party is prohibited from hiring or employing the other party’s personnel.
elements.evidence: Section 12.4 disclaims any no-hire restriction on Customer, Section 12.3 confirms Customer made no no-hire commitment, and no restriction on Vendor hiring Customer personnel appears.

result.reason: The redline fully achieves the preferred position by removing the one-sided solicitation, hiring, and employment prohibition and expressly stating that Customer has no non-solicitation restriction. It does not implement the alternative fallback package because it creates no mutual, service-personnel-limited, 12-month non-solicit and includes no unsolicited-approach carve-out. The revision is confined to the offending clause, preserves the unrelated protections in Section 12.3, and introduces no contradiction.
